unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?
scanNote: 12a-mashqda jadvalga qo'yiladigan belgilar AUDIO orqali beriladi (Lauraning yakshanbasi). Audio yo'q — kitob bergan yagona javob 'go climbing = never'. Qolgan beshtasi uchun namuna gaplar berilgan va ular AUDIO JAVOBI EMAS, balki qolipni mashq qilish uchun ekani whyUz da aniq yozilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about Kim's daily routine and fill in the gaps using phrases from the list. Some of the phrases do not match any of the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Kimning kundalik tartibi haqidagi matnni o'qing va ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. Ba'zi iboralar hech qaysi rasmga to'g'ri kelmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (13 ibora):
  catch the bus, get up, have a shower,
  have breakfast/lunch/dinner, watch TV, go to bed,
  do her homework, get dressed, leave home,
  finish work, read a book, go to work, go dancing

DIQQAT — HAMMASI ISHLATILMAYDI!
Kim — O'QUVCHI, ishchi emas. Shuning uchun:
  finish work, go to work — MOS EMAS
  go dancing — rasmda yo'q

BARCHA FE'LLAR 3-SHAXS BIRLIKDA:
  get up   → gets up
  have     → has
  catch    → catches
  do       → does
  watch    → watches
  read     → reads
  go       → goes

MATNDA VAQT BELGILARI:
  7:30 turish → 8:15 uydan chiqish → 8:45 maktabda →
  9:00 dars boshlanadi → 12:30 tushlik → 3:30 dars tugaydi →
  4:00 uyda → 6:30 kechki ovqat → 8:30 kitob → 9:00 uyqu

lines.textEn: Kim 1) ____ at 7:30 in the morning every weekday.
lines.whyUz: 'get up' → 3-shaxs 'gets up'. 'every weekday' = har ish kuni.
Kiyinishdan keyin — nonushta. 'have breakfast' → 'has breakfast'. Artikl YO'Q.

lines.textEn: She leaves home at about 8:15 and 3) ____ to school.
She arrives at school at about 8:45. School starts at 9 o'clock.
lines.uz: U maktabga taxminan 8:45 da yetib boradi. Dars soat 9 da boshlanadi.

lines.textEn: She 4) ____ at school at 12:30, then has a few more lessons.
School finishes at 3:30 and Kim goes back home. She gets home at 4 o'clock.
lines.uz: Dars 3:30 da tugaydi va Kim uyga qaytadi. U soat 4 da uyga yetib boradi.

lines.textEn: She 5) ____ , then, at about 6:30 in the evening, she has dinner.
lines.whyUz: Maktabdan kelgach uy vazifasi. 'do her homework' → 'does her homework' (-o → -es).
'read a book' → 'reads a book'. Yotishdan oldingi mashg'ulot.

exercises.instructionEn: Some of the phrases do not match any of the pictures. Which ones?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi iboralar hech qaysi rasmga to'g'ri kelmadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCHTA IBORA ORTIQCHA QOLDI.

NEGA? Chunki Kim — MAKTAB O'QUVCHISI:
  go to work   — u ishga bormaydi, maktabga boradi
  finish work  — uning ishi yo'q, darsi bor (school finishes)
  go dancing   — rasmda bunday mashg'ulot yo'q

Bu iboralar baribir Unit 5 lug'atiga kiradi va
12b-mashqda kerak bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: Kim o'quvchi — u 'go to school' qiladi. 'the' YO'Q: go to work.
Rasmda yo'q. 'go + fe'l-ing' — mashg'ulotga borish qolipi.
Ro'yxatda bor, lekin matnda ishlatilmagan (Kim ertalab dush qabul qilishi aytilmagan).
Matnda BERILGAN: 'She leaves home at about 8:15'. 'leave' — 'to' kerak emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose phrases from Ex. 9 and talk about your daily routine. What do you do in the morning/afternoon/evening?
exercises.instructionUz: 9-mashqdagi iboralardan tanlab, o'z kundalik tartibingiz haqida gapiring. Ertalab, kunduzi va kechqurun nima qilasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZINGIZ HAQINGIZDA gapirganda fe'l -s OLMAYDI:
  Kim GETS up at 7:30.   (u)
  I GET up at 7:00.      (men)

UCH QISMGA BO'LIB gapiring:
  In the morning, I ...
  In the afternoon, I ...
  In the evening, I ...

VAQTNI qo'shing — bu gapni aniq qiladi:
  I get up AT seven o'clock.
  I have lunch AT half past twelve.

Quyidagi namunalar — o'z vaqtlaringizni qo'ying.

structure.modelEn: In the morning, I get up at seven o'clock.
I have a shower and then I get dressed.
I have breakfast and I leave home at about half past seven.
I catch the bus to school and I arrive at about eight o'clock.
In the afternoon, I have lunch at school at one o'clock.
School finishes at two o'clock and I go back home.
In the evening, I do my homework.
After that, I usually watch TV or read a book.
I have dinner at seven o'clock and I go to bed at about ten.

rule.explanationUz:
Takrorlanish ravishlari ish QANCHALIK TEZ-TEZ sodir bo'lishini
aytadi. Ular FOIZ shkalasi bo'ylab joylashadi:

  never      0%    — hech qachon
  rarely     10%   — kamdan-kam
  sometimes  25%   — ba'zan
  often      50%   — tez-tez
  usually    75%   — odatda
  always     100%  — doim

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — RAVISH QAYERDA TURADI:

  ODDIY fe'l bilan → fe'ldan OLDIN
    I USUALLY get up at half past seven.
    She NEVER goes climbing.

  'to be' fe'li bilan → fe'ldan KEYIN
    I am NEVER late for school.
    He is ALWAYS happy.

Ya'ni 'to be' — ISTISNO. Boshqa hamma fe'lda ravish oldinda.

rules.uzRule: Takrorlanish ravishlari asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN keladi.
rules.enRule: Adverbs of frequency usually come before the main verb.
examples: I usually get up at half past seven in the morning.
She never goes climbing on Sundays.

rules.enRule: But they come after the verb "to be".
examples: I am never late for school.

rules.uzRule: Ular ish QANCHALIK TEZ-TEZ sodir bo'lishini aytadi.
rules.enRule: They tell us how often something happens.
examples: never 0%, rarely 10%, sometimes 25%, often 50%, usually 75%, always 100%

rule.warningUz:
'NEVER' O'ZI INKOR — ikkinchi inkor QO'SHILMAYDI:
  ✅ She NEVER goes climbing.
  ❌ She never doesn't go climbing.
  ❌ She doesn't never go climbing.

O'zbek tilida 'hech qachon BORMAYDI' — ikki inkor.
Ingliz tilida esa BITTA inkor yetarli.

Shuningdek 'rarely' ham inkor ma'nosini beradi:
  ✅ I rarely watch TV.  (kamdan-kam ko'raman)
rule.noteUz:
SAVOL VA INKORDA ravish QAYERDA:

  Savol: Do you USUALLY get up early?
         (ega va asosiy fe'l orasida)

  Inkor: I don't USUALLY get up early.
         ('don't' dan keyin)

'Sometimes' va 'usually' gap BOSHIDA ham kelishi mumkin:
  Sometimes I go to the cinema.
  Usually I get up at seven.
Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap boshida KELMAYDI.
rule.extraUz:
TAKRORLANISHNI BOSHQA YO'L BILAN AYTISH:
  once a week      — haftada bir marta
  twice a week     — haftada ikki marta
  three times a week — haftada uch marta
  every day        — har kuni
  on Sundays       — yakshanba kunlari

Bu iboralar gap OXIRIDA turadi:
  I go to the gym twice a week.
  She goes climbing on Sundays.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then underline the correct words to complete the rule.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunalarni o'rganing, so'ng qoidani to'ldirish uchun to'g'ri so'zlarni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  I USUALLY get up at half past seven in the morning.
  I am NEVER late for school.

Birinchi gapda 'usually' fe'l 'get up' dan OLDIN.
Ikkinchi gapda 'never' fe'l 'am' dan KEYIN.

QOIDA: 'Adverbs of frequency usually come ____ the main verb,
but ____ the verb to be.'

items.textEn: Adverbs of frequency usually come ____ the main verb.
items.whyUz: Namunada: 'I USUALLY GET UP' — ravish fe'ldan OLDIN.
Namunada: 'I AM NEVER late' — ravish 'am' dan KEYIN. 'to be' — istisno.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adverb in the correct place.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda fe'l turini aniqlang:
  'to be' (am/is/are) → ravish KEYIN
  boshqa fe'l         → ravish OLDIN

items.answer: I usually get up at seven.
I am never late for school.

items.textEn: She watches TV in the evening. (often)
items.answer: She often watches TV in the evening.
They sometimes go to the cinema.
We are usually tired after school.
Bob never swims in the sea.
items.whyUz: 'swims' — oddiy fe'l → ravish OLDIN. 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.

items.answer: My father rarely reads the newspaper.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick the boxes. Then, make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va katakchalarni belgilang. So'ng namunadagidek gap tuzing.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada Laura yakshanba kunlari nima qilishini aytadi. Audio yo'q — kitob faqat BITTA javobni beradi (go climbing = never). Quyidagi qolgan gaplar AUDIO JAVOBI EMAS, balki qolipni mashq qilish uchun namunalar.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL: 6 ta mashg'ulot × 6 ta chastota

  MASHG'ULOTLAR:
    go climbing    — toqqa chiqish
    wash the car   — mashina yuvish
    go to the gym  — sport zaliga borish
    cook           — ovqat pishirish
    go on a picnic — piknikka borish
    go dancing     — raqsga borish

  CHASTOTA SHKALASI:
    never 0% | rarely 10% | sometimes 25% |
    often 50% | usually 75% | always 100%

NAMUNA (kitobda berilgan):
  Laura NEVER goes climbing on Sundays.

QOLIP:
  Laura + RAVISH + fe'l+S + on Sundays.

DIQQAT: 'on Sundays' — KO'PLIKDA, 'har yakshanba' degani.

exercises.instructionEn: Talk about yourself. What do you never/rarely/sometimes/often/usually/always do on Sundays? Choose phrases from the list below. You can add some of your own ideas.
exercises.instructionUz: O'zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Yakshanba kunlari nimani hech qachon / kamdan-kam / ba'zan / tez-tez / odatda / doim qilasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (11 ibora):
  do the washing-up  — idish yuvish
  go jogging         — yugurishga chiqish
  go to the cinema   — kinoga borish
  go shopping        — xaridga borish
  eat out            — tashqarida ovqatlanish
  watch TV           — televizor ko'rish
  go fishing         — baliq ovlashga borish
  visit museums      — muzeylarga borish
  go climbing        — toqqa chiqish
  go windsurfing     — vindserfing qilish
  meet friends       — do'stlar bilan uchrashish

QOLIP (o'zingiz haqingizda — fe'l -s OLMAYDI):
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + on Sundays.
  I always meet friends on Sundays.

DIQQAT — 'go' bilan mashg'ulotlar:
  go jogging, go shopping, go fishing, go climbing,
  go windsurfing, go dancing — hammasi 'go + -ing'
  LEKIN: go TO the cinema (joyga borish — 'to' bilan)

structure.modelEn: I always meet friends on Sundays.
I usually watch TV on Sundays.
I often go shopping on Sundays.
I sometimes go to the cinema on Sundays.
I rarely go jogging on Sundays.
I never go windsurfing on Sundays.
I usually do the washing-up after dinner.
We sometimes eat out at a restaurant.

wordFormation.introUz: 37-bet — kundalik tartib iboralari va takrorlanish ravishlari.

groups.explanationUz: Sport va dam olish mashg'ulotlari uchun 'go' + -ing ishlatiladi. Bu qolipda 'to' YO'Q.
JOY nomi bilan 'to' shart. Mashg'ulot bilan esa 'to' yo'q.
0% dan 100% gacha. Har birining o'z darajasi bor.
Ravishdan tashqari, gap OXIRIDA turadigan iboralar ham bor.

patterns.exampleEn: Kim gets up at 7:30 in the morning every weekday.
patterns.exampleUz: Kim har ish kuni ertalab 7:30 da turadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Kundalik tartib — Present Simple. Soat bilan AT.

patterns.exampleEn: I usually get up at half past seven. She never goes climbing.
patterns.exampleUz: Men odatda yetti yarimda turaman. U hech qachon toqqa chiqmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: I am never late for school. He is always happy.
patterns.exampleUz: Men maktabga hech qachon kechikmayman. U doim xursand.
patterns.explanationUz: 'to be' bilan ravish KEYIN turadi — bu yagona istisno.

patterns.exampleEn: Laura never goes climbing on Sundays.
patterns.exampleUz: Laura yakshanba kunlari hech qachon toqqa chiqmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'on Sundays' — ko'plikda, 'har yakshanba' degani.
'never' bilan 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS.

patterns.formula: She leaves home at ... and catches the bus to school.
patterns.exampleEn: She leaves home at about 8:15 and catches the bus to school.
patterns.exampleUz: U taxminan 8:15 da uydan chiqadi va maktabga avtobusga chiqadi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'leave home' — 'from' kerak emas.
'about' = taxminan (aniq vaqt emas).

patterns.exampleEn: After that, she usually watches TV.
patterns.exampleUz: Shundan keyin u odatda televizor ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'After that' — ketma-ketlikni ko'rsatadi, keyin vergul.
Ravish baribir fe'ldan oldin turadi.
